title: If you are struggling
note: Always available, never behind a flag, one tap from Settings: its own page with the three free, confidential lines (each row starts a call) and the 911 line, word for word. No drawing, no light, no motion.
text: If you are struggling The early months can be very hard. You do not have to carry it alone. These lines are free and confidential. They are for people in the United States. National Maternal Mental Health Hotline Call or text 1-833-852-6262, any time, in English or Spanish. 988 Lifeline Call or text 988, any time. Postpartum Support International Call 1-800-944-4773 and a trained volunteer calls you back. If you or your baby are in danger right now, call 911.
